name: Element Desktop
description: Element Desktop enables Electron autoUpdater on macOS and Windows when update_base_url is configured, using a macOS JSON feed or a Windows Squirrel feed. Its source includes Windows signing build configuration; payload authenticity enforcement remains delegated to Electron/Squirrel and is unresolved here.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; historical release behavior is not reverified.
Electron and Squirrel runtime verification is a delegated framework boundary not established by the cited application files.
